scope: Isolated diagnostic profiling and one exact-six-body candidate replay on physical P150x2 nodes 0/1; separate earlier han2 baseline, not a simultaneous A/B, reboot, broad throughput, or model-quality admission
result: rejected: 94/98 exact gates, four medium-read numeric mismatches, no established material A TTFT gain

diagnostic_profile.measurement: one profiler-enabled isolated B_cold and A_cold refill each; no generated-result or quality admission from profiler timings
diagnostic_profile.interpretation: Per-chip duration sums are not to be summed across the two chips. Device programs closely track refill wall time; enqueues and staging overlap device work. The A-specific SDPA kernel is the largest measured individual program signature, not proof that a tile change will reduce wall time.

rejected_candidate.single_code_change: captured flexible paged-prefill SDPA: q_chunk_size=128 unchanged, k_chunk_size=128 -> 256; eager path unchanged; reverted from repository after failed physical gate
rejected_candidate.package_build: nix build .#packages.x86_64-linux.qwen38 --no-link --print-out-paths -L succeeded with device-free install checks; this is not a physical admission

first_bounded_attempt.result: startup exceeded 1300 seconds during cold kernel JIT and masked-prefill trace capture; no gate was run

package_matched_source_review.constraint: Current 128x128 SDPA uses the full BH grid. nlp_concat_heads is an actual head/sequence permutation feeding attention's sigmoid gate or GDN's SiLU gate and their output projections, not a shape-only view. The profiled binary-SFPU signature aggregates many operations without a proven redundant call; fusing BF16 operations can change exact rounding. No tested alternative removes material device work while retaining the required exact 98-gate.

per_callsite_followup.profiler_metadata_limit: Raw records contain runtime_id, chip_id, timestamps, frequency and kernel-source signature, not TTNN operation names, tensor shapes or Python callsites. The shared binary-SFPU kernel signature cannot independently assign 10.099 s to any single multiply.

exact_repetition.source: model config.json:15,21-85: 64 layers, repeated three linear-attention and one full-attention; model.py:1992-2034 replays that fixed body for every bucket segment

load_bearing_arithmetic: attention/tp.py:700-709 applies trained q_norm and k_norm weights; :803-812 multiplies SDPA by sigmoid(gate) before projection

gdn/tp.py:596-638 projects/causally convolves qkv, makes sigmoid(beta), and multiplies trained neg_exp_A by softplus(a+bias); :655-669 forwards their distinct values into stateful seq recurrence; :709-744 gates normalized output by silu(z) before row projection
ttnn_delta_rule_seq.py:476 scales q by nonunit K^-0.5; :509-510 multiplies v and k by beta; :567-606 applies causal triangle and nonunit 0.25 diagonal regularization
mlp.py:286-328 fuses SiLU in the gate matmul but must still multiply gate and up projections for SwiGLU; layer.py:258-266 retains both trained attention and feedforward residual additions
identity_candidates_not_material_or_safe: model.py:2003-2007 resets 48 GDN recurrent/conv states with two dynamic where selects per layer. They are self-select identities on continuation chunks, but the SAME trace must reset on the first chunk and honor prefix resume; removing selects requires a distinct trace or state/reset protocol, and these are ternary kernels rather than the profiled binary-SFPU signature.

ttnn_delta_rule_seq.py:451-474 multiplies q/k/v/beta/g by a staged valid mask, all ones for full chunks but nonidentity on the final partial bucket; model.py:1980-1985 updates that buffer within one reusable trace. A full-only trace would alter capture/reuse and merely remove at most five masks per GDN layer, without measured material end-to-end benefit.

gdn/tp.py:688-707 refreshes decode conv taps on every segment although only the final window is read by decode. Removing the in-trace state copies requires a separate final-install protocol and preserved prefix/slot invariants; profiler does not attribute a material saving to those calls.
per_callsite_followup.concat_branch: gdn/tp.py:207-208 enables fused output; :711-720 runs nlp_concat_heads on [1,Nv,T,Dv] after head-major recurrence to feed token-major silu(z) and matmul; attention/tp.py:260-264,803-812 likewise converts [1,NH,T,HD] to the trained flat gate column order. With config.json:90 linear_num_value_heads=48 (24/device), neither hot branch is an identical-layout view.
per_callsite_followup.concat_timing_caution: Although signature 46 totals 6.638 s/chip, 61 of 64 calls per 1024-token full chunk stay 0.025-0.047 ms across the first 127 chunks and sum only 0.326 s. The other three calls (last-layer positions 55,59,63) sum 6.309 s, rising from ~0.188 ms on the first chunk to ~32.9 ms by chunk 126 in step with growing SDPA key context even though concat input bucket shape stays fixed. Cause of this program-duration inflation is not isolated; 6.638 s cannot be asserted as pure avoidable permutation cost.

limit: The only tested wider-key SDPA tile changes a consumer-visible exact structured-read score and shows just 0.5163 s A TTFT difference (~0.5%) against one separate prior han2 run. No safe material improvement was demonstrated; no candidate deployment or general quality claim.
